description.text:
The runner-up deck of the Senior Division at the 2010 World Championships, built on Gyarados's Tail Revenge, an attack that costs no Energy and does damage for each Magikarp in the discard pile. Felicity's Drawing puts the Magikarp there while drawing cards, Crobat G adds damage and Luxray GL LV.X switches the opponent's Pokémon. Gyarados decks had surprised players at the 2009 World Championships and kept doing well. The 2010 World Championships were held at the Hilton Waikoloa Village in Waikoloa Village, Hawaii, from 13 to 15 August 2010.

Pokémon sold it as a 2010 World Championships deck: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet and a deck box. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
